rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a Day 5 Gardner 2BA blastocyst, including full blastocoel, B-grade ICM, and A-grade TE. Minor overreach includes comments on zona thickness/normality and cell uniformity that may not be confidently inferred from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, tubal factor, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, sperm motility, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status with embryo quality to frame prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo grade and patient factors. Minor issues include somewhat confident quantitative adjustments and overstating TE as the primary implantation driver.

Generally aligned with IVF practice: eSET in a good-prognosis young patient, no routine ERA/PGT-A, and cautious use of assisted hatching. Small deviations include optional estradiol/luteal specifics and some recommendations that are more center-dependent than guideline-driven.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including eSET, when to consider additional testing, and future-cycle considerations. Some suggestions are somewhat generic or speculative without cycle-specific details.
